Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `progressive-blur` - `layer` - `root`: `data-side` (`bottom` | `inline-end` | `inline-start` | `top`), `data-visible` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### progressive-blur - `--cui-progressive-blur-size`: `3rem` - `--cui-progressive-blur-backdrop-blur`: `16px` - `--cui-progressive-blur-fade-size`: `0.5rem` - `--cui-progressive-blur-transition-duration`: `var(--duration-base)` - `--cui-progressive-blur-transition-delay`: `calc(var(--cui-progressive-blur-transition-duration) * 0.06)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/progressive-blur - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/progressive-blur.json
